findings.detail: Description of "cra_scope_check" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: security_txt_generate · Private data: cra_scope_check, security_txt_generate, cra_technical_documentation_checklist, sbom_vulnerabilities · Public sink: cra_reporting_deadlines, cra_report_draft · Destructive: sbom_summarize.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: security_txt_generate · Private data: cra_scope_check, security_txt_generate, cra_technical_documentation_checklist, sbom_vulnerabilities · Public sink: cra_reporting_deadlines, cra_report_draft · Destructive: sbom_summarize

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
